Class Tile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AlienLifeSupportsSystem, BatteryComponents, Cabin, Cannon, CargoHold, Engine, Pipe, Shields, VoidTile
public abstract class Tile extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
Abstract class representing a tile component in the ship grid. All ship components such as cabins, engines, cannons, etc. extend this base class. Each tile has directional connectors, rotation, coordinates, and a unique key.
